observations: Photo 0 shows a Toyota engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with many hoses/wiring harnesses attached; an intake manifold and valve cover are visible.
Photo 1 shows the same engine assembly from another angle; a large black air intake/ducting cover is visible along with more attached components.

Photo 2 shows the engine with the large plastic engine cover/airbox area and the intake/throttle-side components; the assembly appears incomplete/partially disassembled around the edges (some parts/wiring not fully shown).
No clear engine code/label, VIN plate, or model badge is readable in the photos provided.
The seller’s watermark text appears on the images, but it does not provide readable engine identification.

identity.kind: complete Toyota engine assembly with attached intake/air components and related parts (seller says includes compressor and operators)

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for Toyota Venza, Camry, Sienna, Highlander,...
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly with hoses/wiring and intake components, but no readable compressor label/part number or clear confirmation that the exact compressor and all required “operators” for those specific models are included.
No shipping documents, import markings, or identifiable Belgium sourcing evidence is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm internal engine condition (knock), mileage, or whether the engine has been opened; no test video/scan report is shown.

risks.risk: Exact engine variant/engine code is not readable; wrong engine for the buyer’s vehicle can cause fitment and ECU/compatibility issues.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/label (e.g., on the engine block/head) and the transmission/ECU part numbers, plus a photo showing the compressor part number if included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Toyota engine assembly with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not fit or may require additional parts).

risks.risk: Seller claim of “compressor included” may be incorrect or may not match the required A/C compressor type for the target model/year.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the compressor unit with its label/part number and connection ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine assembly only (worst-case: compressor not included or not usable).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified remotely; internal damage (bearing noise, timing issues) may exist.
risks.proof: Short start-up video (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no knocking, plus a mechanic’s sound check note.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened / low mileage” cannot be confirmed; head gasket leaks, oil leaks, or prior repairs may be present.
risks.proof: Photos of gasket surfaces and any opened/repair marks, plus compression test results or leak-down test results.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown history (worst-case: assume wear and potential leaks).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: “all the operators” is vague; missing sensors, brackets, mounts, wiring connectors, or cooling components can increase cost.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo laid out (or a checklist) showing every included component and connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/label on the block/head (and any stamping) and the transmission code if attached.
Close-up photo of the A/C compressor (if included) showing its label/part number and connections.
Start-up video showing the engine running smoothly (and ideally a cold start) with no knocking.
Compression test or leak-down test results (or a mechanic’s report) and any scan/diagnostic report if available.
A component inventory/checklist photo showing exactly what is included (sensors, brackets, mounts, hoses, ECU/TCU if applicable).
response.reason: The photos show a Toyota engine assembly, but the exact engine variant and whether the compressor and all required components are truly included cannot be confirmed, and the “tested/working/no knock/low mileage/never opened” claims are not verifiable from images alone. Proof is needed to price confidently.
